outcome: Length of first and second stage of labor
cohort: 232 patients diagnosed with maternal hypertensive disorder
finding: Continuous epidural analgesia in patients with maternal hypertensive disorder was associated with a higher rate of natural delivery and improved 1-minute Apgar scores in neonates without affecting the length of labor or other neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Continuous epidural analgesia in patients with maternal hypertensive disorder was associated with a higher rate of natural delivery.
